Trusted Contact is an optional safety feature in ChatGPT.
Trusted Contact allows adults to nominate someone they trust, such as a friend, family member, or caregiver.
A nominated person may be notified if our automated systems and trained reviewers detect the enrolled person may have discussed harming themselves in a way that indicates a serious safety concern.
Trusted Contact is designed to offer another layer of support alongside the localized helplines already available in ChatGPT.
Trusted Contact helps users connect to a person they trust when they are in crisis.
Trusted Contact builds on parental controls safety notifications.
